newsitem.title: JAPAN: Investors chase after blue chip shares in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Investors chase after blue chip shares in Tokyo.

text.p: Enthusiasm for blue chip shares heightened in early Wednesday morning trade, as key issues such as Toyota Motor Corp and Canon Inc hit record highs for the year, brokers said.

Shares of Toyota Motor were 20 yen higher at 2,920 yen, exceeding the previous high of 2,910 set on Tuesday. Turnover was 1.57 million shares, the seventh most heavily traded issue on the first section of the exchange.
Canon rose 50 yen to 2,390 yen, surpassing the previous high of 2,370.
